settings.title: Settings

trial.title: Free trial
trial.body: Pick a plan to keep blocking and every game after the trial.

warn.offBody: Untangle can't step in until Accessibility is on again.
warn.batteryBody: Battery use isn't set to Unrestricted. Your phone may close Untangle in the background.

settings.goalSub: Games or detours a day for your streak
settings.deleteBody: Your locks, progress, streak and game history are erased from this phone. Your subscription is not cancelled; do that in Google Play.
settings.oemSub: Some phones stop apps in the background unless you allow it.
settings.oemSteps: Open Settings › Apps › Untangle and allow auto-start or background activity.

sees.title: What Untangle sees
sees.body: The name of the app in front, and the address of the site in supported browsers. That's how it knows when to show your moment of pause.

never.title: What it never sees
never.body: Your messages, what you type, what's on the screen inside an app, your photos or your contacts.

stays.title: Everything stays on your phone
stays.body: No account, no server, no analytics. Only Google Play and RevenueCat see your purchase.
